semiconductor_relevance: High — Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment Inc. is a key supplier of micro-fabrication equipment for the semiconductor industry, particularly in advanced manufacturing processes.
summary: Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment Inc. (AMEC) provides innovative micro-fabrication equipment and process expertise to the semiconductor industry. The company specializes in equipment for front-end manufacturing, back-end wafer level packaging, and MEMS applications, supporting chipmakers at process nodes as low as 5nm.
capabilities: MOCVD tools for GaN LED production
ALD equipment for advanced material deposition
